answer_1.quote: We apply RSA-Control to GPT2 ... open-ended generation ... In Section 6, we control Llama-2-7bchat ... for readability-controlled summarization.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate readability with Flesch Reading Ease (FRE...), Dale‑Chall readability (DCR...), Gunning fog index (GFI...), and Coleman‑Liau index (CLI...). BERTScore and Rouge‑L (RG‑L) are reported to reflect summary quality. We also compute the conditional perplexity score (PPL) of each continuation using GPT‑J.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 20 news articles along with RSA‑Control and baseline summaries for human evaluation. For each sample, three annotators rate the informativeness and faithfulness of each summary on a scale of 1 to 5 and rank them by readability. ... Human evaluation results of toxicity reduction ... annotators rate toxicity, fluency and coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate generated texts according to specified criteria such as toxicity, fluency, coherence (for open‑ended generation) and informativeness, faithfulness, readability (for summarization).
